title: The contract bundle manifest, seampact-bundle.json (ADR 0011)
description: A reader checks this schema, then the rules no JSON Schema states (README.md, 'Manifest rules'): files sorted by path in code-unit order with no duplicate, even folded to ASCII lower case, each api's file listed and named ir/<api>.json, and no key given twice in one object.

formatVersion.description: The bundle format version; a reader refuses one it does not read.

contract.description: The contract package the bundle was made from.

apis.description: Each api of the workspace, with the IR file and the IR version and revision it was written in.

compiler.description: The compiler that wrote the IR.

packs.description: The packs the apis apply (each IR's packs), sorted by name then version in code-unit order, without duplicates.

files.description: Every file of the bundle but the manifest, sorted by path in code-unit order.

integrity.description: sha256- and the padded standard base64 of the SHA-256 of the canonical file list.

label.description: A name or version: printable ASCII with no space, so every language orders and prints it alike.

path.description: A portable path: relative to the bundle root, forward slashes, under sources/ or ir/, each segment of [A-Za-z0-9._@+-], not ending in . (so neither . nor ..), and not a Windows device name (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM0-9, LPT0-9, any case) before its first . (no lookahead, so RE2-based validators read it)
